expectations.text: Blocks insemination when Animal.etat_gestation == 'GESTANTE' (with eligibility VACHE/GENISSE), referencing CF-IA / the guard.
expectations.evidence: with_skill/outputs/insemination.py validate_animal_eligible() fetches both categorie and etat_gestation (lines 66-68: frappe.db.get_value("Animal", self.animal, ["categorie", "etat_gestation"])), rejects non-VACHE/GENISSE (line 71: 'if categorie not in ("VACHE", "GENISSE")' -> ERR-IA-01) and blocks GESTANTE (line 79: 'if self.is_new() and etat_gestation == "GESTANTE"' -> ERR-IA-06). NOTES.md cites the guard: 'CF-ANI-04 / CF-IA ... only an ACTIF, female VACHE/GENISSE is repro-eligible; ... a GESTANTE animal is excluded.'

expectations.text: On REUSSIE computes date_velage_prevue = add_days(date_ia, get_config('periode_velage_jours', 280)).
expectations.evidence: with_skill/outputs/insemination.py lines 117-120: 'periode_velage = get_config("periode_velage_jours", default=280)' then 'animal.date_velage_prevue = frappe.utils.add_days(self.date_ia, periode_velage)', inside the 'if self.resultat == "REUSSIE"' branch.

expectations.text: Writes the protected reproduction/gestation fields via flags.ignore_validate and uses get_config (no hardcoded 280/60/9-months).
expectations.evidence: with_skill/outputs/insemination.py lines 128-133 set id_ia_fecondante, etat_gestation, date_velage_prevue, date_tarissement then 'animal.flags.ignore_validate = True; animal.save()'. Both windows come from get_config (lines 117, 123); 280/60 appear only as get_config defaults, no hardcoded literals or 9-months.
